description: This file defines a handler for creating teams, including logic for billing, team creation, logo upload, and validation within a TRPC-based API.

methods.name: generateCheckoutSession
methods.description: Generates a checkout session for team billing if enabled, returning the session URL or throwing an error.

methods.name: createHandler
methods.description: Main handler function to create a team, handle billing, validate slug uniqueness, upload logo, and return team info or checkout URL.

methods.name: isSlugTakenBySomeUserInTheOrganization
methods.description: Checks if a slug is already taken by a user within an organization.
